description: Run a coordinated swarm of coding agents: one Mayor thread plans work in a Beads ledger and slings each task to a worker in its own worktree. Verified work lands as a pushed branch with its bead moved to review, and merges stay yours — merged PRs close their own beads and archive their threads. Polecats review their own work in their own worktree; adversarial reviews run lite or one-reviewer-per-lens. GitHub, GitLab, and Gitea/Forgejo rigs are all supported (auto-detected per rig, or pinned). A Town Hall board shows every bead, and patrols sweep for cruft and security issues. Requires BB 0.49+ and the Beads CLI (bd) on the BB host.
